identification: Sciter 3.3.2.2 / sciter32.dll, Terra Informatica HTML/CSS and TIScript UI runtime
judgment: Coherent rendering, scripting and UI implementation; traced message hooks, clipboard API binding and CRT failure paths fit this library. No traced autonomous theft, persistence or payload chain. The containing malware does not transfer its intent to this member.
limitations: No execution of the sample or contact with sample endpoints. Static capability findings do not establish runtime success.
Vendor authenticity and original delivery provenance were not independently authenticated; version and publisher are unverified embedded claims.
The container is supplied as confirmed malware and was not re-judged. Its benign classifier output is a remaining classifier miss.

extraction.target_span: 0x3ad000 bytes (historical SizeOfImage carve), matches the supplied SHA-256
extraction.tail: 31,744 bytes beginning with PNG magic, followed by PNG assets; not a mapped executable section. Current parent scanning carves only the physical PE, so both hashes were compared.

reverse_engineering: 494 imported symbols, one SciterAPI export, coherent CSS/HTML, image, networking and TIScript class/vtable surface; internal version string 3.3.2.2. No executable section packing layer was found in this member.

Entry 0x1023c69a performs CRT initialization, then dispatches DLL attach/detach. DLL callback 0x1001c4fd releases engine state on detach and returns success on attach. SciterAPI at 0x10014102 returns an engine function table at 0x10350040.

Hook installers 0x10032e19 and 0x1015fb00 push hook type 3 (WH_GETMESSAGE). The first selects the current thread; the second installs a global message hook. Callback 0x1015fa70 checks TOOL-EXEC-ASYNC and dispatches the queued callback before CallNextHookEx. This is message dispatch, not a key recorder.

Clipboard 0x100ad3ca handles Unicode text/custom formats, GlobalLock/Unlock, conversion and CloseClipboard. TIScript API dispatcher 0x1018ee16 exposes clipboard get/change behavior, including GetClipboardSequenceNumber at 0x1018f109. Existing neutral clipboard/input findings are preserved.

HttpSendRequestA helper 0x10125b02 accepts request arguments from its caller. On error 12045 it follows configurable handling; branch 0x10125b76 queries security option 31, ORs 0x100 into a DWORD, passes that same DWORD to InternetSetOptionW at 0x10125ba3 and retries. This is optional unknown-CA acceptance, not demonstrated exfiltration or C2.

CreateProcessW at 0x1026e80b is in a parameterized CRT spawn implementation; it manages inherited handles, wait/exit-code behavior and handle cleanup. ShellExecuteExW at 0x1018cece follows parsed TIScript arguments. These establish execution capabilities without a hostile payload chain.

IsDebuggerPresent callers 0x1023d500 and 0x10244907 construct failure/exception information and call UnhandledExceptionFilter; the latter terminates with 0xc0000409 on stack-cookie failure. Existing notable debugger API observations remain; no evasion objective was added.
Multimedia timer 0x1021cd50 pushes a callback at 0x1021ad60, user argument and timing values before timeSetEvent at 0x1021cd8d. A timer import does not establish audio input.

Decoded-string candidates were inspected: percent-decoded candidates derive from printf/date format strings; Base64 candidates include incidental binary/PNG text. They do not reveal an executable stage. No obfuscation or hostile intent was inferred from decoder guesses.

changes.reason: Multimedia callback scheduling is not audio capture. Import matcher, file/platform scope, confidence and notable severity are unchanged; Dacic consumer updated.

Duplicate hostname-resolution observation in the wrong home. The retired composite joined any DLL ordinal 51/52 to a WS2_32 name, permitting a false association; the retained YARA rule binds the ordinal to WS2_32 itself. Real Sciter and MSMP loader positives retain DNS coverage.

Missing certificate-handling capability. Requires executable-section bytes, the unknown-CA mask, identical local buffer slots, DWORD length, security-option number and a call bound to InternetSetOptionA/W. Notable, not an attack claim.

reference_audit: No live exact or ancestor YAML consumers select the removed ip/resolve rule. Historical relocation records are unchanged. The timer has one exact Dacic consumer, updated. Two audio-directory exclusions apply only to JavaScript, disjoint from the PE/DLL timer; no suppression membership changes there.

Real concealed browser stealer; all 2 hostile/2 suspicious findings retained.

classifier: Member BENIGN before and after, confidence 0.9738553; agreement with manual judgment. Confirmed-malware container BENIGN before and after, confidence 0.9868095; pre-existing classifier miss. Scans warn that installed v18 features lag expected v21.
material_detection_losses: None. One duplicate neutral DNS finding removed; its correct DNS counterpart remains. Timer observation moved without a severity/matcher change. Every existing hostile/suspicious finding in the container and regression malware remains.
